Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product Features
Snow-covered realistic design: Create a charming winter scene at home with this 4ft flocked Christmas tree. Individually crafted realistic PE tips are paired with inner PVC tips, creating an exceptionally realistic, full and thick holiday tree, while the white flocking adds a realistic snowy finish.
Dynamic glow: Pre-lit with 160 warm white LEDs, this Christmas tree offers 8 lighting modes, including steady glow, twinkle and flashing effects. Easily switch between settings with the built-in controller or remote control to create a great festive atmosphere.
Light-up pot base: Finished with a stylish white plastic pot, the base allows light to shine through for an extra magical glow. The compact design makes it easy to place on tables, shelves, entrances, or other indoor spaces.
Flame-retardant materials: Crafted from flame-retardant PVC tips and flocking, this frosted Christmas tree is designed for seasonal decorating. Paired with a low-voltage adapter, it delivers a steady glow for your holiday display.
Space-saving storage: This artificial Christmas tree features a 3-section trunk, assembling in around 10-15 minutes. After the holidays, the sectioned design allows easy disassembly and compact storage, keeping your festive tree neatly organised.

Decorative items shown in the pictures are not included in the delivery.

Does it need assembly?
Simple assembly required — the tree sections connect together (with built-in power sockets linking the lights automatically) and attach to the stand with 3 hand-tightened bolts, no power tools needed. Once assembled, gently spread out the branches and tips to shape your tree.

What lighting modes does it have?

How are the lights powered?

Is it suitable for outdoor use?

Product Introduction
Capture quiet forest Christmas vibes with this deep green velvet bauble collection. The matte velvet finish brings warm, soft texture, complemented by fine gold star glitter that sparkles softly under warm lights. Four different textures add rich depth
 to your festive styling. No harsh bright reflections, just calm, elegant winter charm. Shatterproof and lightweight, easy to arrange and reposition. It comes in a delicate gift box for gifting to lovers of subtle vintage decor.
Product Specifications

 Count: 12 pcs, four textured designs
 Size: 6 cm
 Surface: Flocked velvet with gold star glitter print
 Inner: Unbreakable plastic
 Fitting: Golden hanging cap
 Packaging: Separate grid kraft box

Application Scenarios
Christmas tree styling, fireplace decor, festive table styling, photo backdrop props, shelf vignettes, holiday wreath accents, cottage-style home and slow-living aesthetic shooting scenes.
Notes

 Avoid rubbing against rough surfaces to reduce glitter loss.
 Keep away from direct strong sunlight for long periods to prevent colour fading.
 Do not soak in water.
 Hang steadily to prevent falling and collision.
12 Pcs Christmas Bauble Set with 4 Mixed Styles: This set includes 12 dark green velvet Christmas balls, 3 of each design. Different textures and gold star glitter patterns match each other well, saving your time on matching ornaments.
Soft Flocked Surface with Eye-catching Glitter Details: The velvet surface is smooth to touch. Fine gold star glitter adds gentle sparkle under warm lights, upgrading the festive look of your home.
Unbreakable Plastic, Safe for Household Use: Shatterproof plastic construction avoids the risk of broken glass. Each ornament comes with a reliable golden hanging cap, ready to hang directly out of the package.
Wide Application for Holiday Decor: Ideal for Christmas tree decoration, garlands, wreaths, table arrangements, shelf displays and shop window decor. Suitable for family holiday parties and seasonal gift giving.
Practical Partition Packaging: The compartment kraft box prevents ornaments from scratching each other. It can be used as a storage box after Christmas for long-term reuse.

Christmas Baubles
Add colour and detail to your Christmas tree with these decorative baubles. Their hanging format lets you spread the ornaments through the branches or combine them with other suitable festive displays for a coordinated seasonal arrangement.

Pumpkin Design
The pumpkin design gives the display a recognisable seasonal theme. Use it as a focal detail within an autumn or Halloween arrangement, pairing it with suitable surrounding decorations for a coordinated finish.

Shatter Resistant Design
The ornaments use a shatter resistant construction for the stated decorative use. They provide an alternative to traditional glass decorations when arranging the display, while retaining a defined shape and finish for the festive setting.

Hanging Cord
The hanging cord gives the ornament a defined attachment point for a suitable support. It allows the decorative face to remain visible and makes it easy to include the piece among other hanging accents in the intended display.

Reusable Design
The reusable format is intended to be used again after suitable care. Keep it clean and store it between uses so it remains ready for the next occasion.

Compact Format
The compact format helps the item fit into a smaller working or storage area. It is useful where you want the function close to hand without filling the whole space.

Removable Design
The removable design allows the relevant part to be taken off when needed. It gives more flexibility when arranging, cleaning or storing the product according to its intended use.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Product details
Material: Plastic. Colour: Multicoloured. Product measurements: length 5 cm, width 5 cm, height 40 cm. Quantity: 20 pack.
Shatter-resistant plastic construction ensures safe, durable festive decoration.
Includes hanging cord for easy display on tree branches or other supports.
Reusable design allows for convenient cleaning and long-term seasonal storage.
Compact pumpkin-shaped ornaments add a distinctive autumnal theme to displays.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Resistant to shattering
Included: Hanging cord

5056797098930.sourceDescription:
Bring a classic festive reindeer to your garden with this 108 x 73cm light up silhouette from MySmartBuy. It is lit with 358 multicolour micro LEDs on a durable metal frame. The stand keeps it upright on lawns and in borders. It is supplied with a 5m lead cable, giving plenty of reach from your socket, and the built-in timer lights it for 6 hours and then switches it off for 18 hours, so it comes on at the same time every evening without you needing to remember. Ground spikes are included to hold it securely on lawns, in borders and beside pathways. Light up figures are one of the easiest ways to make your home stand out at Christmas. Group several together to tell a festive story on the lawn, use them to frame the front door or path, or place one where it can be seen from the window so the whole family can enjoy it from inside too. Pair it with other MySmartBuy light up figures, trees and wreaths to build a full festive display that neighbours, visitors and passers-by will love. At a glance: 108 x 73cm reindeer silhouette | 358 multicolour micro LEDs | metal frame with stand | ground spikes included | 5m lead cable | 6 hours on / 18 hours off timer | outdoor use.
108 x 73CM REINDEER SILHOUETTE : 358 multicolour micro LEDs on a durable metal frame.
STAND INCLUDED : Free-standing for lawns and borders.
5M LEAD CABLE : Supplied with a 5m lead cable, giving plenty of reach from your socket to your chosen spot.
AUTOMATIC TIMER : Built-in 6 hours on / 18 hours off timer, so it lights up at the same time every evening without you having to remember.
OUTDOOR CHRISTMAS DISPLAY : Gardens, lawns, porches and pathways.

Place it on your table, fireplace mantel, craft displays, or show window; it also works great in offices, coffee shops, and homes, infusing any space with festive cheer wherever you put it.
Pretty Retro Design: Ideal Christmas Gift
With its pretty, retro appearance and vivid design options, this tabletop Christmas tree carries your good wishes perfectly. It makes a thoughtful Christmas present for friends and relatives—whether they’re decorating a small apartment, adding charm to their office, or looking for a cozy holiday accent, this tree is sure to be a beloved gift.

Christmas Wreath
This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Padded Construction
The padded construction adds a cushioned layer to the design. It gives the relevant contact area a softer feel and is a useful detail for the stated carrying or wearing arrangement.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Snowflake Detail
Snowflake detailing adds a winter themed accent to the design. The pattern can be used alongside simpler decorations to vary the visual texture of a seasonal arrangement while keeping the display within a coordinated festive theme.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

5096042277130.variantName: Fibre optic Christmas wreath - Light-up door wreath - Warm white fibre optic lighting for a hallway or living room - Green, 50 cm
5096042277130.sourceDescription:
Warm white light picks out fine strands amongst the 72 tips of this 50 cm wreath. Three AA batteries, supplied separately, power the fibre optic display and give you freedom to choose the hanging position.

Fibre optics bring light to the ends of fine strands, giving the greenery scattered highlights. Seen close up, the small points sit at different depths among the branches. From across the room they draw the eye around the outline. The fine illuminated ends are part of the decorative effect. Keep them visible among the branches and leave the front of the wreath free from large additions that would hide the small points of light.

Warm white light works well alongside wood, brass and cream finishes. If you already have lighting in the same part of the room, see how the two colours look together at dusk before choosing the final position. Allow access to the battery compartment when arranging the display. Positioning it where you can change the cells without disturbing the front of the decoration makes a difference if you leave it up throughout the season.

The centre opening lets the background play a part in the design. Pale paint gives the foliage a sharp outline, while a darker panel draws attention to the texture at the tips of the branches.

Think about access to the controls before choosing the final position. Leave enough room to reach the switch comfortably while keeping the front of the arrangement clear, especially if you plan to change the lighting during the evening. After the festive season, lay the decoration in a box with space around its edges. Keep heavy ornaments and tightly coiled strings of lights separate so that the front of the wreath keeps its shape in storage.

A narrow ribbon in a colour taken from the design makes a discreet finishing touch if you use your own hanger.
Warm white fibre optic lighting illuminates 72 branch tips for a festive glow.
Compact 50 cm diameter design fits perfectly on doors, walls or hallways.
Battery operated with three AA cells (sold separately) for flexible placement.
Green foliage with scattered light highlights creates a subtle decorative effect.
Batteries sold separately

5096042275730.baseName: Christmas wreath - Festive door decoration - Gold bells and star details for hanging on a door or wall, Green and gold, 30 cm
5096042275730.variantName: Christmas wreath - Festive door decoration - Gold bells and star details for hanging on a door or wall, Green and gold, 30 cm
5096042275730.sourceDescription:
Gold bells, stars and a Christmas greeting sit against a green PVC wreath. The pale flower detail stands out amongst the metallic ornaments, giving a small door or wall space several distinct details to enjoy up close. It can be used indoors or outdoors, so the same decoration can move between a hallway and an entrance as your plans change. At 30 cm across, it is easy to measure out the space it will occupy before choosing a position.

A wreath puts the decoration on the door or wall itself, leaving the console or mantelpiece below free for cards and winter flowers. Its outline is complete in one piece, which is handy in an entrance where there is little space for a tree.

Hung on a panelled door, a wreath looks best when the edges of the panel still show. Centre it on the panel itself and look at it from the far end of the hall before choosing the final hanging height. After the festive season, lay the decoration in a box with space around its edges. Keep heavy ornaments and tightly coiled strings of lights separate so that the front of the wreath keeps its shape in storage.

On a mantel wall, the wreath can sit above the display while the shelf below stays clear for cards and small ornaments. Leave a little space between the top of the cards and the bottom of the wreath so their outlines remain distinct. To carry the colours into the rest of the room, pick out one detail from the wreath and repeat it in wrapping ribbon, a table runner or decorations on the tree. Even a single matching accent can bring two separate displays together.

For a wall arrangement, try the wreath above a narrow console with the centre of the design just below eye level. A clear strip of wall between the wreath and the furniture shows off the outline and leaves the surface free for keys or Christmas cards.
Compact 30 cm diameter design ideal for small doors or walls.
Versatile indoor and outdoor use for flexible festive decorating.
Features gold bells, star details and a Merry Christmas greeting.
Complete one-piece wreath shape requires no assembly.

Light with a purpose
Place the light where its effect will be most useful within the intended setting. The position influences how the surrounding surfaces look, so consider nearby furniture, reflective finishes and the direction from which the light will be viewed.

Build a considered arrangement
Lighting can help define a particular part of a room or display. Combine the product with the lighting already present and adjust its position to create the balance you want, allowing practical room lighting and decorative accents to work together.

Make the most of the design
Give the light enough surrounding space for its shape and illumination to be appreciated. A clear position helps prevent neighbouring objects from obscuring the effect and makes the product easier to reach for ordinary operation or care.

Match the setting
Use the stated power method and suitability when choosing a location. Consider access to the controls and any required connection, keeping the arrangement practical for the way the area is used throughout the day.

Care and storage
Switch off and disconnect the light as directed before cleaning. Follow the care instructions for the housing and light source, and keep removable parts together if the product is packed away between displays or occasions.
